chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, who said:
I asked Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) about a man who enjoys the concubinage of a man's slave girl with his permission; he said: 'Yes.'

key_terms.يَتَمَتّعُ: He enjoys (specifically refers to concubinage or sexual use)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to have sexual relations with a slave girl owned by someone else?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) confirms the validity of *Tamattu'* (temporary concubinage) with a slave girl owned by another man, contingent upon the owner's consent. It underscores the flexibility of Shia jurisprudence regarding private property rights in slaves, distinguishing this arrangement from permanent marriage while affirming its ritual purity and legal standing. The ruling reflects the practical social structures of the early Islamic period, where slave ownership was regulated by clear contractual permissions.
